name: Kagutsuchi Hino
source:
"When something happens, let me know."
"Don't be so considerate in front of me."

A childhood friend who attends the same college.

He’s always optimistic and hates to lose. He has outstanding reflexes and leads the college’s futsal club. He has a lot of secret admirers at school, and a number of girls have confessed their love to him.

He always turns them down gently, apologizing and saying that he already has someone he likes.
Unfortunately, this gentlemanly gesture seems to have the opposite effect, upsetting a lot of the girls, who scream at him that they won’t soon forget the rejection.

His hobby is collecting cute merchandise. Being a guy, though, he’s slightly embarrassed about it and tries his best to keep it a secret.
